<template>
    <v-container>
      <v-row>
        <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="4">
          <v-text-field
            v-model="formattedDate"
            label="Date"
            placeholder="DD/MM/YYYY"
            :rules="[dateFormatRule]"
            @input="updateDate"
            @blur="formatDate"
            hide-details="auto"
          >
            <template v-slot:append>
              <v-icon @click="showDatePicker = true">mdi-calendar</v-icon>
            </template>
          </v-text-field>
        </v-col>
      </v-row>
  
      <v-dialog v-model="showDatePicker" max-width="290px">
        <v-date-picker v-model="date" @update:model-value="selectDate"></v-date-picker>
      </v-dialog>
    </v-container>
  </template>
  
  <script>
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import { format, parse, isValid } from 'date-fns'
  
  export default {
    setup() {
      const date = ref(new Date())
      const showDatePicker = ref(false)
      const formattedDate = ref('')
  
      const updateDate = (value) => {
        const parsedDate = parse(value, 'dd/MMM/yyyy', new Date())
        if (isValid(parsedDate)) {
          date.value = parsedDate
        }
      }
  
      const formatDate = () => {
        formattedDate.value = format(date.value, 'dd/MMM/yyyy')
      }
  
      const selectDate = (newDate) => {
        date.value = newDate
        formattedDate.value = format(new Date(newDate), 'dd/MMM/yyyy')
        showDatePicker.value = false
      }
  
      const dateFormatRule = (value) => {
        if (!value) return true
        const parsedDate = parse(value, 'dd/MMM/yyyy', new Date())
        return isValid(parsedDate) || 'Invalid date format. Use DD/MMM/YYYY'
      }
  
      return {
        date,
        showDatePicker,
        formattedDate,
        updateDate,
        formatDate,
        selectDate,
        dateFormatRule,
      }
    },
  }
  </script>
